name: resume_filters
title: Resume Filters
summary: Language / model filters, sort and search for a resume_listing.
description: Toolbar for a resume_listing (look and drawer from filters_toolbar), linked by "id" to the <ul id> of the listing; give it the same type, lang, filter_by and exclude_by as the listing. "filters" picks the filters and their order (default ["lang", "model"]); a filter with fewer than two options is left out. Language labels come from lang_labels, models from model_label ("Model {n}"). Texts: lang_label, model_label_filter, search_placeholder, results_text ("Showing {n} resumes."), empty_text. Sort: sort_fields (default publish date, then title).
